tool_input.description: 检查应用配置的数据库键名
tool_input.command:
$login = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.168.1.12:8848/nacos/v1/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -Body 'username=nacos&password={{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/password}}' -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
$token = [string](($login.Content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop).accessToken)
$configUri = 'http://192.168.1.12:8848/nacos/v1/cs/configs?dataId=application-dev.yml&group=DEFAULT_GROUP&tenant=zscloud&accessToken=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($token)
$text = [string](Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $configUri -Method Get -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15).Content
'APP_CONFIG_LENGTH=' + $text.Length
'APP_HAS_DATASOURCE=' + [bool]([regex]::IsMatch($text, '(?i)datasource|jdbc|druid'))
foreach ($line in ($text -split "`r?`n")) { $m = [regex]::Match($line, '^(\s*)([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)\s*:'); if ($m.Success) { 'indent=' + $m.Groups[1].Length + ' key=' + $m.Groups[2].Value } }
